teaser: Keeping a household running and chasing the next change of scenery rarely live in the same person comfortably. You do both: life path 5, the Adventurer, crossed with ESFJ, the Consul. One restless for variety, one steady for belonging. You can be the one who smooths over a long afternoon of obligations and still feel the itch to be anywhere else before the day ends. That double pull is the shape of this reading.
